name: Argonauts
source:
Main character Naoki decides to have a space travel experience during his summer vacations. Somehow, he is assigned to a team consisting only of girls who are all musicians. It's supposed to be a fun youth voyage, but spacecraft route is crazy and full of surprises. First, the vehicle gets damaged, then space pirates attack. Will the young people finish this journey safely?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Argonauts was a joint development project between Fairytale and [url=https://vndb.org/p823]Panda House[/url], hence the Fairytale team Panda label.
translation:
主人公直树决定在暑假体验一次太空旅行。不知为何，他被分进了一支全员都是女性音乐家的队伍。原本应该是一趟欢乐的青春之旅，飞船的航线却异常离谱，途中更是意外不断。先是飞船受损，随后又遭到太空海盗袭击。这群年轻人能平安完成旅程吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]

《Argonauts》由Fairytale与[url=https://vndb.org/p823]Panda House[/url]联合开发，因此使用了Fairytale team Panda这一品牌名称。
